subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata attempt-result contract and classified server_error retry-before-failover behavior after the branch is refreshed and proof is added?
rationale: The change affects SDK-exported harness results plus provider retry, session-state, and message-delivery semantics; code review can identify the tradeoff, but maintainers need to choose the compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept with proof
options.body: Require conflict resolution plus redacted full-runner or gateway proof, then accept the optional field and retry ordering as the canonical fix shape.

options.title: Preserve the bug until a narrower contract exists
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers do not want a new attempt-result field or server_error retry-before-failover ordering.

options.title: Choose another candidate PR
options.body: Use another open candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 as the canonical implementation and close this PR after preserving useful test/proof context.

recommendation.title: Accept with proof
recommendation.body: Require conflict resolution plus redacted full-runner or gateway proof, then accept the optional field and retry ordering as the canonical fix shape.
